zen.text: Sea Gate is the battleground where Gideon learns to lead: his first assault dissolves into a rout, and Tazri tells him it failed because he led from the front and gave his army no plan.
Over several days he builds a plan that gives every contingent a role, and with Kiora's forces and Nissa's elementals marching through the streets, the army reclaims the city from the Eldrazi.
When Jori En warns that Ulamog is coming, Gideon refuses to evacuate and the defenders trap the titan in a ring of hedrons, until a demon strikes at the sentry Ebi and Ulamog breaks free again.
Ob Nixilis, whose spark returns, knocks a hedron out of alignment and collapses the network, and Kozilek rises from the bay and rips open the sea wall, letting the Halimar Sea pour through.

bfz.text: Sea Gate falls to the Eldrazi in Battle for Zendikar, and survivors flee, among them Nissa, who stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi without Zendikar's voice until Gideon lashes one away and leads the survivors to safety.
Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces, and everyone who can lift a weapon helps retake Sea Gate, after which Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog there in a ring of hedrons.

Then Ob Nixilis knocks the hedrons out of alignment to reignite his spark and calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging as the Gatewatch forms on the cliffs overlooking the city, and after the titans' defeat Sea Gate is rebuilt.

ogw.text: In Oath of the Gatewatch, Sea Gate is where Ulamog stands ready to succumb before Kozilek arises, emerging as his brood swarms to the surface.
Kozilek destroys Sea Gate and the Halimar basin is drained, and the Gatewatch's oath is heard near its ruins.

znr.text: In Zendikar Rising, Sea Gate is a city rebuilt: Commander Tazri drafts a plan backed by Linvala and it is restored within a year.

Nahiri arrives there and, with Kesenya, recruits Akiri's party to retrieve the Lithoform Core from a Murasa Skyclave, and the adventurers who breach Emeria go on to form the Sea Gate Expeditionary House.
Jace also arrives looking for Nissa, meets Mara at the memorial of six upright hedrons, and finds that Kesenya has secretly written Murasa on a note.

j25.text: In Foundations Jumpstart, Sea Gate has fallen, but Gideon rallies those who still stand to keep fighting.
